generation.program:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((dots (find-color g 2))
                  (r1 (first (first dots)))
                  (c1 (snd (first dots)))
                  (r2 (first (last dots)))
                  (c2 (snd (last dots)))
                  (minr (min r1 r2))
                  (maxr (max r1 r2))
                  (minc (min c1 c2))
                  (maxc (max c1 c2)))
             (cellmap g
                      (r c v)
                      (cond
                        ((or (= r r1) (= r r2) (= c c1) (= c c2)) 2)
                        ((and (>= r minr) (<= r maxr) (>= c minc) (<= c maxc)) 1)
                        (else 0)))))))

(rule! (lambda (g)
  (let* ((h (rows g))
         (w (cols g))
         (dots (find-color g 2))
         (p1 (first dots))
         (p2 (last dots))
         (r1 (first p1))
         (c1 (second p1))
         (r2 (first p2))
         (c2 (second p2))
         (minr (min r1 r2))
         (maxr (max r1 r2))
         (minc (min c1 c2))
         (maxc (max c1 c2))
         (base
           (grid-from-fn h w
             (lambda (r c)
               (cond
                 ((or (= r r1) (= r r2) (= c c1) (= c c2)) 2)
                 ((and (>= r minr) (<= r maxr)
                       (>= c minc) (<= c maxc)) 1)
                 (else 0)))))
         (cue-pos
           (find-first
             (lambda (p)
               (let* ((r (first p))
                      (c (second p))
                      (v (at g r c)))
                 (and (= (at base r c) 1)
                      (not (= v 0))
                      (not (= v 2)))))
             (grid-positions g)))
         (cue-color
           (if cue-pos
               (at g (first cue-pos) (second cue-pos))
               -1)))
    (grid-from-fn h w
      (lambda (r c)
        (let ((b (at base r c))
              (v (at g r c)))
          (if (and (= b 0) (= v cue-color)) 8 b)))))))
